reason: Bank-blind model evaluation after manual actual-library calibration. Includes independent rejected-domain checks for hidden getters/coercion and exact namespace integration. No grading program or bank entry in proposal context.

scope.description: Finite acyclic arrays (including holes), primitives and ordinary React element/portal data with scalar keys. Elements and fragments are leaves; their children are not traversed. Empty top-level input skips traversal, nested empty nodes are normalized to null. Observe count or exact forEach callback argument/index/receiver, return identity and throws. Iterator/thenable/lazy protocols, library-read getters, nonprimitive key coercion, symbol keys, owner Fiber graphs and input mutations require separate evidence. Unaccessed element warning descriptors remain opaque.
